attempt_accounting.excluded_attempt_reason: An earlier launch began in the live repository rather than an exact checkpoint export and was interrupted immediately; it produced no retained review and is not counted as evidence.

limitations: This is an accepted same-model review, not an independent-family review.
The reviewer's graph calls were blocked, so it used direct full-source inspection, immutable Git-object verification, and deterministic artifact recomputation.
The review is revision-bound to the stated checkpoint and tree and grants no production or corpus-selection authority.
